CHAT REPLIES

Your stream reaches viewers a few seconds late, but chat doesn't, so results can spoil the surprise. Set this to your stream delay (Twitch is usually 2 to 5 seconds, Kick 3 to 6) and every spin result, bonus, badge, minigame and level-up message waits that long, so it shows up in chat right as viewers see it happen.
The timed leaderboard and commands posts are in Settings > Timed chat messages. !leaderboard and !commands always answer on request, even with replies off.
Posts from your own Twitch or Kick account, so connect above first. Each reply goes to the chat the player spun from.

EMOTES

LOAD EMOTES

Connect Twitch or Kick on the CONNECT page and your emotes load by themselves. Use these buttons to switch between your Twitch and Kick emotes. Until then, demo symbols are used.

REEL EMOTES

Click an emote to add it to or remove it from the reels. Machine symbols are always on the reels. Use as many as you like: each spin draws from a random 6 of them (plus one legendary and one mythic), so the odds stay the same.

SETTINGS

GAME VERSION

VIDEO

For Window Capture in OBS: shows only the machine, sized to fill this window. Press Esc or hover and click MENU to come back. The background uses the colour from ADD TO OBS (black if that's set to transparent).
Turn off Flashing win effects and Neon flicker if your viewers might be sensitive to flashing lights. These settings are saved into your OBS link.
Chat commands: !spin (or !spin 50 to bet more), !points, !daily (1,000 free points every 24 hours), !leaderboard.

MACHINE

TIMED CHAT MESSAGES

They go to every chat you're connected to, from your own account. A post is skipped if the chat has been quiet since the last one, so nobody gets spammed.

GLOBAL LEADERBOARD

Every machine is on the global leaderboard at yhandor.com/leaderboard, and Sparks are shared on every channel.

POINTS

Export saves every player's points, levels, XP, badges and stats, plus the jackpot, tournament, counters and your settings, to one file on your PC. Import it on any computer to bring everything back.

TOURNAMENT

    Everyone starts at 0. Every point won from a spin during the tournament counts, and it's kept separate from the main points leaderboard. In chat, !tournament (or !tlb) posts the top 10 while a tournament is running; when it ends, the final results are posted once. You can also type !tournament start, !tournament start Name or !tournament end in your own chat, which is handy when the machine is running in OBS.

    ADD TO OBS

    Add a Browser Source in OBS, leave "Local file" unchecked and paste this as the URL. It shows only the machine, connects to chat by itself and uses the capture settings below. Set the source size to .
    This link now contains your sign-in. Keep it private: never show it on stream or share it.

    CAPTURE SETTINGS

    Transparent works with a Browser Source. Use a green or magenta screen only if you capture the window instead, then add a Chroma Key filter in OBS.
    With auto-hide on, the machine fades away when it's quiet and powers back on the moment someone types !spin.
